_doc: s148g pilot only (SITE_S148G.md item 9): drafted per-choice reasons for the five sample banks, [key, d1, d2], from each item's own explanation and the brief's rows. They do not ship in s148g; the reviewed reasons ship in s148h.
q_680ca34e827e516c9a90: Blocks dopamine D2 receptors; reduces impairing tics
Treats ADHD; not a tic treatment
q_7b955ba5483e524c9908: Tics that do not impair: explain the course and watch
q_c04a5b7c0b9458c5a156: A tic has no obsession behind it
Diffuse worry; no compulsion to neutralize it
q_7f29f6e3d9b55a11837d: Needs motor and vocal tics for 1 year
Needs tics for 1 year or more
q_f9b8abcdb1605c38a9dc: SSRIs treat comorbid OCD, not tics
q_11071c3e784a5dac9722: ADHD still impairing after an alpha-2 agonist
Treats OCD or depression, not ADHD
q_6c20bd3174595d3d82b0: An SSRI does not reduce tics
Alpha-2 agonist: accepted for milder tics
Behavioral first line for impairing tics
q_a94ac1ab85b156bb8084: Accepted tic medication; fewer extrapyramidal effects
q_86cee7a24272810f29cb: Tricyclic on board: check the QRS first
For neuroleptic malignant syndrome; tone is normal
q_dd578b9f5d822990ef0a: Wide QRS predicts seizures and arrhythmia
Comes late; does not track toxicity
Dilated pupils carry no prognostic value
q_f7a62d4005d61c28b69f: Can worsen cardiotoxicity once a tricyclic is involved
q_77be58aec1d909e6dcbd: Pure anticholinergic: no tricyclic, narrow QRS
For a QRS over 100 ms; this one is 88
q_173bf52e87b18bc8001a: Hot dry skin, big pupils, retention, quiet bowel
Lead-pipe rigidity on a dopamine blocker
q_12fd7e26de5eb429d402: Mood shifts in hours, abandonment fear, self-injury
Needs a depressive episode of 2 weeks or more
q_1fe65106a3cd14dc257a: Age 18 or older, no remorse, conduct disorder before 15
Grandiosity and need for admiration, not lawbreaking
q_b5b3d2d48170f2690f97: Theft, fighting, cruelty and truancy under 18
Defiance without aggression, cruelty or property violations
q_37976a2b6c3cbf952640: Best evidence in borderline personality disorder
Adjunct only; no bipolar disorder here
q_62499936c58ac677b46a: Theatrical, seductive and attention seeking since her teens
Mania: an episode with less sleep and rapid speech
q_6d7d62f9f280e4c403e3: Often found in borderline personality disorder
Points to a psychotic disorder, not borderline
Manic episodes are not part of borderline
q_825dd34c39a6fefa51c5: Criterion A for 1 to under 6 months
Prominent voices: more than a delusion alone
q_7dfe8050588133fa1bce: Criterion A with decline for 6 months or more
Voices and negative symptoms: more than a delusion
q_c3ab6df88757aa298544: Voices 2 weeks with normal mood; mood most of the illness
Mood episodes only a minority of the illness
q_b3db6c76ffbbc3d98f8c: One delusion for 1 month or more; functioning intact
Needs a second Criterion A symptom
Needs a manic episode; mood is normal
q_84e5c9dd0796f8bbc02d: Psychosis 2 weeks or more alone; depression most of the illness
Mood episodes only a minority of the illness
q_29765c80940704a6c8b7: Psychosis only during the manic episode
Needs 2 weeks of psychosis without a mood episode
Excluded when a mood episode explains the psychosis
q_d94a444dc335c58a8169: Excluded when a drug explains the timing
q_d6b532ef5ba9ee4150cb: After a marked stressor; well within a month
Intrusion, avoidance and arousal; none here
Needs a delusion for 1 month or more
q_4f7e99d406dda2fff18d: First-line test for a drug cause
Needs a neurologic finding or history
q_5af4628002a964e1149f: Likely harm to others: admit first
Unsafe: he bought a knife to confront them
Unsafe with a plan to harm others
q_733a1cffb70304fef48c: For poor adherence; adherence is confirmed
q_2646e702c06eefba5d28: Mood episodes only a minority of the illness
q_20fb01b347baf25d4571: Antipsychotic for the psychosis; SSRI for the depression
A mood stabilizer is for bipolar type
q_cc182d77d4694cbcd721: Clonus, hyperreflexia and sweating after adding tramadol
Lead-pipe rigidity over days on a dopamine blocker
Dry skin and quiet bowel; no clonus
q_0564f671fc7cbee2a9a1: Only once she is medically clear
q_c5662dbd795e002baaa4: Pinpoint pupils with slow breathing: opioid
Only if naloxone brings no quick response
For benzodiazepines, which leave the pupils normal
q_bc6605f71caccfec26b3: Sedation and slow breathing; no secretions
q_8f48c9780eb3e49fdd97: Fever, tinnitus and fast, deep breathing
Big pupils and dry skin; no tinnitus
q_3d4f3bb449249b384e19: An SSRI alone rarely confuses: look for another drug
For refractory serotonin syndrome; no clonus here
